headline: Grupo Pão de Açúcar secures labor court approval to pay $24 million debt over 72 months
summary: Brazilian retailer Grupo Pão de Açúcar received judicial approval to pay approximately 140 million reais ($24 million) in labor obligations in 72 monthly installments under its debt restructuring plan.
why: GPA is one of Brazil's largest food retailers, operating supermarket chains across the country.
